page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.12xlarge is an x86_64 server instance powered by the AMD EPYC processor family and deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance provisions 48 dedicated vCPUs operating at a frequency of 2.25 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory. This resource profile establishes a 1:2 compute-to-memory distribution of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware accelerators are not included, with GPU count sitting at zero. The instance does not bundle local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions for disk operations and host persistence. Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 13 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned with the base provisioning.

Given the high dedicated core count relative to the 96 GB memory pool, this configuration offers strong resource density for compute-bound tasks that do not depend on expansive memory caching. It is suited for multi-threaded batch operations, software compilation in CI/CD pipelines, web serving clusters, and containerized backend workloads.
